future_steps.text: Add regression fixtures for nested awaits, conditional suspension, task groups, detached tasks, and actor hops, verifying severity downgrades, preserved sequential severity, and suppression of duplicate witnesses.

Add SARIF and GitHub Code Scanning end-to-end validation for multiline locations, Windows and URI-encoded paths, multiple code-flow threads, stable fingerprints, and findings on changed versus unchanged lines.
Introduce baseline and suppression support so CI can fail on newly introduced findings while retaining existing concurrency signals and their fingerprints.
Render concurrency witnesses in the local UI as two labeled timelines with isolation boundaries, while keeping the signal-versus-proof disclaimer visible at the point of interpretation.
Add bounded-resource behavior for advanced and ci-full analysis, including cancellation, timeouts, and actionable diagnostics when large projects exhaust analysis limits.
Expose the selected profile and loaded rule-pack versions in CLI and report metadata so local, offline CI, SARIF, and IDE results can be reproduced reliably.

features: Conservative severity for findings after await or task suspension
High-severity findings for clear sequential crash and misuse cases
Main-actor and cross-isolation concurrency signals
Sibling-task shared-state dual-timeline witnesses
Explicit pattern-witness framing instead of global race claims
SARIF locations, path details, fingerprints, and concurrency code flows
GitHub Code Scanning PR annotation workflow
Scrollable findings panel with reorganized detail view
VS Code deep links from finding locations
Ultra assist profile with core and advanced rule packs
Offline ci-full profile for advanced CI findings
head_story.text: Analysis now treats await and task hops as uncertainty boundaries, so findings after suspension no longer receive an unjustified high severity while clear sequential cases retain their stronger severity. Advanced analysis reports isolation mismatches and narrow sibling-task shared-state witnesses, explicitly framing them as concurrency signals rather than proof of a race. Reports can feed IDEs and GitHub Code Scanning through richer SARIF, while the local UI offers clearer finding details, scrolling, and editor links. Explore, REPL, and serve use an ultra assist profile with advanced rule packs, alongside an opt-in offline full CI profile.

detail.body:
Day-to-day `explore`, `repl`, and `serve` now use an "ultra" assist
profile with core + advanced packs, redacted privacy, LLM help, and
bounded call summaries. This aligns the interactive workflow with the
richer tracing model described in the docs.

Add a separate `ci-full` gate profile for offline `analyze` runs that
need advanced rule packs, while keeping `ci` as the boring core-only
nightly default. This gives teams an explicit opt-in path for deeper
findings without changing the conservative gate.

Expose `bug_type` and witness notes in the REPL and web UI, and update
the operator guides and sample configs to describe the new profile
split. Concurrency findings are now framed as pattern witnesses so they
are less likely to be mistaken for full race-freedom claims.

detail.body:
Add an NS4 dual-timeline witness for unprotected shared state accessed
from sibling Swift Tasks. This gives CI a narrower concurrency finding
that reports the specific pattern the engine can observe, rather than
lumping it into a broader heuristic signal.

Update the Swift parser helper so trailing closures and closure bodies
are encoded in a way the analyzer can inspect. Add fixture coverage and
golden tests for the positive spawnRace case and the negative
spawnThenAwait and singleTask cases. Also clarify the operator guide so
this concurrency result is described as a pattern-scoped witness, not a
claim of global race freedom.

+"""NS4 dual-timeline race witnesses (narrow sibling-Task pattern)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Literal, Sequence
+
+from ultra_trace.cfg.walk import expressions_by_id, walk_expressions
+from ultra_trace.engine.async_edges import task_hop_style
+from ultra_trace.engine.explorer import ExplorationResult, TaskHopEvent
+from ultra_trace.frontend.models import (
+    AssignmentPayload,
+    CallPayload,
+    CollectionPayload,
+    FrontendSymbol,
+    FrontendUnit,
+    IdentifierPayload,
+    MemberAccessPayload,
+    NormalizedExpression,
+    SharedMutableCandidate,
+    SourceSpan,
+    flatten_statements,
+)
+
+AccessKind = Literal["read", "write"]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ExecutionContext:
+    context_id: str
+    kind: Literal["parent", "task"]
+    style: str | None = None
+    hop_expression_id: str | None = None
+    location: SourceSpan | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AccessEvent:
+    context_id: str
+    location_key: tuple[str | None, str]
+    kind: AccessKind
+    location: SourceSpan
+    evidence: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DualTimelineWitness:
+    shared_name: str
+    parent_type: str | None
+    access_a: AccessEvent
+    access_b: AccessEvent
+    context_a: ExecutionContext
+    context_b: ExecutionContext
+    sync_gap: str
+    shared_location: SourceSpan
+
+
+def find_sibling_task_race_witnesses(
+    *,
+    symbol: FrontendSymbol,
+    exploration: ExplorationResult,
+    unit: FrontendUnit,
+    max_pairs: int = 1,
+) -> tuple[DualTimelineWitness, ...]:
+    """Bounded matcher: one unprotected shared var across sibling Task hops."""
+    if symbol.body is None or max_pairs <= 0:
+        return ()
+    hops = _task_hops_for_symbol(symbol, exploration)
+    if len(hops) < 2:
+        return ()
+    exprs = expressions_by_id(symbol.body)
+    if _parent_await_joins_after_hops(symbol, hops, exprs):
+        return ()
+
+    witnesses: list[DualTimelineWitness] = []
+    for candidate in unit.shared_mutables:
+        key = (candidate.parent_type, candidate.name)
+        ctx_accesses: list[tuple[ExecutionContext, AccessEvent]] = []
+        for hop in hops:
+            ctx = ExecutionContext(
+                context_id=f"task:{hop.expression_id}",
+                kind="task",
+                style=hop.style,
+                hop_expression_id=hop.expression_id,
+                location=hop.location,
+            )
+            for access in _accesses_in_task_hop(
+                hop.expression_id, exprs, unit, candidate, ctx.context_id
+            ):
+                ctx_accesses.append((ctx, access))
+        # Need accesses from ≥2 distinct task contexts, with ≥1 write.
+        by_ctx: dict[str, list[tuple[ExecutionContext, AccessEvent]]] = {}
+        for ctx, access in ctx_accesses:
+            by_ctx.setdefault(ctx.context_id, []).append((ctx, access))
+        if len(by_ctx) < 2:
+            continue
+        writes = [
+            (ctx, acc)
+            for pairs in by_ctx.values()
+            for ctx, acc in pairs
+            if acc.kind == "write"
+        ]
+        if not writes:
+            continue
+        # Prefer pairing a write with an access from another context.
+        write_ctx, write_acc = sorted(
+            writes,
+            key=lambda p: (p[1].location.start_line, p[0].context_id),
+        )[0]
+        other = None
+        for cid, pairs in sorted(by_ctx.items()):
+            if cid == write_ctx.context_id:
+                continue
+            other = sorted(
+                pairs,
+                key=lambda p: (p[1].location.start_line, p[0].context_id),
+            )[0]
+            break
+        if other is None:
+            continue
+        other_ctx, other_acc = other
+        witnesses.append(
+            DualTimelineWitness(
+                shared_name=candidate.name,
+                parent_type=candidate.parent_type,
+                access_a=write_acc,
+                access_b=other_acc,
+                context_a=write_ctx,
+                context_b=other_ctx,
+                sync_gap="no await/join between sibling Tasks",
+                shared_location=candidate.location,
+            )
+        )
+        if len(witnesses) >= max_pairs:
+            break
+    return tuple(witnesses)
+
+
+def _task_hops_for_symbol(
+    symbol: FrontendSymbol, exploration: ExplorationResult
+) -> tuple[TaskHopEvent, ...]:
+    hops = [h for h in exploration.task_hops]
+    # Deduplicate by expression id; keep explorer order.
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    out: list[TaskHopEvent] = []
+    for hop in hops:
+        if hop.expression_id in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(hop.expression_id)
+        out.append(hop)
+    if out:
+        return tuple(out)
+    # Fallback: scan body for Task creation calls if explorer missed them.
+    if symbol.body is None:
+        return ()
+    exprs = expressions_by_id(symbol.body)
+    found: list[TaskHopEvent] = []
+    for expr in exprs.values():
+        if expr.kind != "call" or not isinstance(expr.payload, CallPayload):
+            continue
+        style = task_hop_style(expr.payload.callee_text or "")
+        if style is None:
+            continue
+        found.append(
+            TaskHopEvent(
+                expression_id=expr.expression_id,
+                location=expr.location,
+                style=style,
+                path_node_ids=(),
+            )
+        )
+    return tuple(found)
+
+
+def _parent_await_joins_after_hops(
+    symbol: FrontendSymbol,
+    hops: Sequence[TaskHopEvent],
+    exprs: dict[str, NormalizedExpression],
+) -> bool:
+    """Conservative: any await after the last sibling Task hop suppresses the race."""
+    if not hops or symbol.body is None:
+        return False
+    last_line = max(h.location.start_line for h in hops)
+    for expr in exprs.values():
+        if expr.kind == "await" and expr.location.start_line > last_line:
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def _accesses_in_task_hop(
+    hop_expression_id: str,
+    exprs: dict[str, NormalizedExpression],
+    unit: FrontendUnit,
+    candidate: SharedMutableCandidate,
+    context_id: str,
+) -> tuple[AccessEvent, ...]:
+    hop = exprs.get(hop_expression_id)
+    if hop is None or not isinstance(hop.payload, CallPayload):
+        return ()
+    out: list[AccessEvent] = []
+    for arg_id in hop.payload.argument_expression_ids:
+        out.extend(
+            _accesses_in_expr_tree(arg_id, exprs, unit, candidate, context_id, depth=0)
+        )
+    return tuple(out)
+
+
+def _accesses_in_expr_tree(
+    root_id: str,
+    exprs: dict[str, NormalizedExpression],
+    unit: FrontendUnit,
+    candidate: SharedMutableCandidate,
+    context_id: str,
+    *,
+    depth: int,
+) -> list[AccessEvent]:
+    if depth > 4 or root_id not in exprs:
+        return []
+    out: list[AccessEvent] = []
+    key = (candidate.parent_type, candidate.name)
+    for expr in walk_expressions(root_id, exprs):
+        if expr.kind == "identifier" and isinstance(expr.payload, IdentifierPayload):
+            if expr.payload.name == candidate.name:
+                out.append(
+                    AccessEvent(
+                        context_id=context_id,
+                        location_key=key,
+                        kind="read",
+                        location=expr.location,
+                        evidence=f"read `{candidate.name}`",
+                    )
+                )
+        if expr.kind == "member_access" and isinstance(
+            expr.payload, MemberAccessPayload

+                out.append(
+                    AccessEvent(
+                        context_id=context_id,
+                        location_key=key,
+                        kind="read",
+                        location=expr.location,
+                        evidence=f"read `.{candidate.name}`",
+                    )
+                )
+        if expr.kind == "call" and isinstance(expr.payload, CallPayload):
+            callee = _resolve_callee(expr.payload, unit)
+            if callee is not None and _symbol_writes_candidate(callee, candidate):
+                out.append(
+                    AccessEvent(
+                        context_id=context_id,
+                        location_key=key,
+                        kind="write",
+                        location=expr.location,
+                        evidence=f"call `{callee.qualified_name}` writes `{candidate.name}`",
+                    )
+                )
+            elif callee is not None and _symbol_reads_candidate(callee, candidate):
+                out.append(
+                    AccessEvent(
+                        context_id=context_id,
+                        location_key=key,
+                        kind="read",
+                        location=expr.location,
+                        evidence=f"call `{callee.qualified_name}` reads `{candidate.name}`",
+                    )
+                )
+        if expr.kind == "closure_expression" and isinstance(
+            expr.payload, CollectionPayload
+        ):
+            for eid in expr.payload.element_expression_ids:
+                out.extend(
+                    _accesses_in_expr_tree(
+                        eid, exprs, unit, candidate, context_id, depth=depth + 1
+                    )
+                )

+    # treat assignment-to-shared as write when the assign target is the shared name.
+    return _promote_assignment_writes(root_id, exprs, candidate, context_id, out)
+
+
+def _promote_assignment_writes(
+    root_id: str,
+    exprs: dict[str, NormalizedExpression],
+    candidate: SharedMutableCandidate,
+    context_id: str,
+    accesses: list[AccessEvent],
+) -> list[AccessEvent]:
+    # Closures only expose expression elements; assignment statements inside closures
+    # may appear as call/identifier trees only. Keep reads/writes as collected.
+    del root_id, exprs, candidate, context_id
+    return accesses
+
+
+def _resolve_callee(
+    payload: CallPayload, unit: FrontendUnit
+) -> FrontendSymbol | None:
+    if payload.resolved_callee_symbol_id:
+        return unit.symbols_by_id.get(payload.resolved_callee_symbol_id)
+    text = (payload.callee_text or "").strip()
+    if not text:
+        return None
+    short = text.split(".")[-1]
+    matches = [
+        s
+        for s in unit.symbols_by_id.values()
+        if s.name == short or s.qualified_name == text
+    ]
+    if len(matches) == 1:
+        return matches[0]
+    return None
+

+def _symbol_writes_candidate(
+    symbol: FrontendSymbol, candidate: SharedMutableCandidate
+) -> bool:
+    if symbol.body is None:
+        return False
+    exprs = expressions_by_id(symbol.body)
+    for stmt in flatten_statements(symbol.body.statements):
+        if isinstance(stmt.payload, AssignmentPayload):
+            target_id = stmt.payload.target_expression_id
+            if target_id and _expr_names_candidate(target_id, exprs, candidate):
+                return True
+        # var reassignment via expression statements is uncommon; also scan identifiers
+        # in binary/assignment-like forms already covered by AssignmentPayload.
+        from ultra_trace.cfg.walk import statement_root_expression_ids
+
+        for root in statement_root_expression_ids(stmt):
+            for expr in walk_expressions(root, exprs):
+                if expr.kind == "identifier" and isinstance(
+                    expr.payload, IdentifierPayload
+                ):
+                    # Heuristic: presence alone is not a write; need assignment payload.
+                    continue
+    # Also: `counter = 1` as assignment is the main write form.
+    for stmt in flatten_statements(symbol.body.statements):
+        if not isinstance(stmt.payload, AssignmentPayload):
+            continue
+        tid = stmt.payload.target_expression_id
+        if tid and _expr_names_candidate(tid, exprs, candidate):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def _symbol_reads_candidate(
+    symbol: FrontendSymbol, candidate: SharedMutableCandidate
+) -> bool:
+    if symbol.body is None:
+        return False
+    exprs = expressions_by_id(symbol.body)
+    for stmt in flatten_statements(symbol.body.statements):
+        from ultra_trace.cfg.walk import statement_root_expression_ids
+
+        for root in statement_root_expression_ids(stmt):
+            for expr in walk_expressions(root, exprs):
+                if _expr_is_candidate_ref(expr, candidate):
+                    return True
+    return False
+
+
+def _expr_names_candidate(
+    expr_id: str,
+    exprs: dict[str, NormalizedExpression],
+    candidate: SharedMutableCandidate,
+) -> bool:
+    expr = exprs.get(expr_id)
+    if expr is None:
+        return False
+    return _expr_is_candidate_ref(expr, candidate)
+
+
+def _expr_is_candidate_ref(
+    expr: NormalizedExpression, candidate: SharedMutableCandidate
+) -> bool:
+    if expr.kind == "identifier" and isinstance(expr.payload, IdentifierPayload):
+        return expr.payload.name == candidate.name
+    if expr.kind == "member_access" and isinstance(expr.payload, MemberAccessPayload):
+        return expr.payload.member == candidate.name
+    return False
+
+
+def format_dual_timeline_summary(witness: DualTimelineWitness) -> str:
+    a = witness.context_a
+    b = witness.context_b
+    return (
+        f"dual_timeline; shared=`{witness.shared_name}`; "
+        f"timeline_a={a.style or 'task'}@{a.location.start_line if a.location else '?'}→"
+        f"{witness.access_a.kind}@{witness.access_a.location.start_line}; "
+        f"timeline_b={b.style or 'task'}@{b.location.start_line if b.location else '?'}→"
+        f"{witness.access_b.kind}@{witness.access_b.location.start_line}; "
+        f"sync_gap={witness.sync_gap}"
+    )

+"""NS4: unprotected shared var across sibling Tasks (dual-timeline witness)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from ultra_trace.cfg.models import ControlFlowGraph
+from ultra_trace.core.findings import Finding
+from ultra_trace.engine.dual_timeline import (
+    DualTimelineWitness,
+    find_sibling_task_race_witnesses,
+    format_dual_timeline_summary,
+)
+from ultra_trace.engine.explorer import ExplorationResult
+from ultra_trace.frontend.models import FrontendSymbol, FrontendUnit
+from ultra_trace.proofs.generator import repro_proof
+from ultra_trace.rules.emit import emit_finding
+
+RULE_ID = "swift.sibling_task_unprotected_shared_race"
+
+
+class SiblingTaskUnprotectedSharedRaceRule:
+    rule_id = RULE_ID
+
+    def evaluate(
+        self,
+        *,
+        symbol: FrontendSymbol,
+        cfg: ControlFlowGraph,
+        exploration: ExplorationResult,
+        unit: FrontendUnit,
+    ) -> list[Finding]:
+        del cfg
+        if symbol.body is None:
+            return []
+        if symbol.eligibility.state not in {"cfg-ready", "partially-analyzed"}:
+            return []
+        if not unit.shared_mutables:
+            return []
+        witnesses = find_sibling_task_race_witnesses(
+            symbol=symbol,
+            exploration=exploration,
+            unit=unit,
+            max_pairs=1,
+        )
+        findings = [_finding(symbol, w) for w in witnesses]
+        findings.sort(key=lambda f: (f.location.file_path, f.location.start_line, f.id))
+        return findings
+
+
+def _finding(symbol: FrontendSymbol, witness: DualTimelineWitness) -> Finding:
+    path_summary = format_dual_timeline_summary(witness)
+    steps = (
+        f"Timeline A (`{witness.context_a.context_id}`):\n"
+        f"  - {witness.context_a.style or 'task'} hop at "
+        f"L{witness.context_a.location.start_line if witness.context_a.location else '?'}\n"
+        f"  - {witness.access_a.evidence} at "
+        f"L{witness.access_a.location.start_line}\n"
+        f"Timeline B (`{witness.context_b.context_id}`):\n"
+        f"  - {witness.context_b.style or 'task'} hop at "
+        f"L{witness.context_b.location.start_line if witness.context_b.location else '?'}\n"
+        f"  - {witness.access_b.evidence} at "
+        f"L{witness.access_b.location.start_line}\n"
+        f"Sync gap: {witness.sync_gap}\n"
+        "This is a pattern-scoped dual-timeline race witness for sibling Tasks only. "
+        "It does not prove global race freedom."
+    )
+    proof = repro_proof(
+        trigger=(
+            f"Call `{symbol.qualified_name}` so sibling Tasks touch shared "
+            f"`{witness.shared_name}` without a join."
+        ),
+        expected=(
+            "Dual-timeline witness for unprotected concurrent access. "
+            "Pattern-scoped; not a global race proof."
+        ),
+        steps=steps,
+        assumptions=(
+            "Sibling Task / Task.detached hops only; TaskGroup and actor hops excluded.",
+            "No lock/GCD/queue happens-before model.",
+            "Await after the last Task hop suppresses this witness (conservative join).",
+            "Does not claim races outside this narrow pattern.",
+        ),
+        high=False,
+        medium_kind="dual_timeline_witness",
+    )
+    return emit_finding(
+        rule_id=RULE_ID,
+        title="Unprotected concurrent access across sibling Tasks",
+        symbol=symbol,
+        location=witness.shared_location,
+        bug_type="concurrency",
+        description=(
+            f"Shared `{witness.shared_name}` is written/accessed from sibling Task "
+            f"timelines without a modeled sync edge. {path_summary}"
+        ),
+        risk=(
+            "Concurrent mutation of shared state can race. Confirm with Swift "
+            "concurrency tooling; this finding is a dual-timeline witness for one "
+            "narrow pattern, not a global race proof."
+        ),
+        path_summary=path_summary,
+        recommended_fix=(
+            "Isolate the mutable state in an actor, protect it with synchronization, "
+            "or await/join Tasks before overlapping access."
+        ),
+        proof=proof,
+        severity="medium",
+        confidence="medium",
+    )

+"""NS3 isolation helpers: derive domains from attributes and symbol kind."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Sequence
+
+from ultra_trace.frontend.models import IsolationKind, SymbolKind
+
+
+def normalize_attribute_name(raw: str) -> str:
+    text = raw.strip()
+    if text.startswith("@"):
+        text = text[1:]
+    # Drop generic arguments: MainActor(...) -> MainActor
+    if "(" in text:
+        text = text.split("(", 1)[0]
+    return text
+
+
+def isolation_from_attributes(
+    attributes: Sequence[str],
+    *,
+    nonisolated: bool = False,
+    symbol_kind: SymbolKind | None = None,
+    parent_is_actor: bool = False,
+) -> IsolationKind:
+    """Conservative isolation label. Unknown stays unknown only when conflicting."""
+    if nonisolated or any(
+        normalize_attribute_name(a) == "nonisolated" for a in attributes
+    ):
+        return "nonisolated"
+    names = {normalize_attribute_name(a) for a in attributes}
+    if "MainActor" in names:
+        return "main_actor"
+    if symbol_kind == "actor" or parent_is_actor:
+        return "actor"
+    return "unspecified"
+
+
+def isolation_domains_differ(a: IsolationKind, b: IsolationKind) -> bool:
+    if a == b:
+        return False
+    # Unspecified calling into a clear domain (or the reverse) is still a signal.
+    if "unspecified" in {a, b} or "unknown" in {a, b}:
+        other = b if a in {"unspecified", "unknown"} else a
+        return other in {"main_actor", "actor", "nonisolated"}
+    return True

+    rule_id = RULE_ID

+    def evaluate(
+        self,
+        *,

+        cfg: ControlFlowGraph,
+        exploration: ExplorationResult,

+def _symbol_references(
+    symbol: FrontendSymbol, candidate: SharedMutableCandidate
+) -> bool:
+    assert symbol.body is not None
+    exprs = expressions_by_id(symbol.body)

+    if candidate.parent_type:

+        trigger=(
+            f"Exercise `{accessors}` so they read or write shared `{candidate.name}` "
+            f"at {candidate.location.file_path}:{candidate.location.start_line}."
+        ),
+        expected=(
+            "Heuristic shared-mutable cross-isolation signal. "
+            "Not a proven data race."
+        ),
+        steps=(
+            f"1. Note shared mutable `{candidate.name}` "
+            f"(parent={candidate.parent_type or 'file'}).\n"
+            f"2. Observe accessors with domains {domains}: {accessors}\n"
+            "3. Review isolation; do not treat this finding as a race proof."

+            "Name-based access matching; no happens-before / lock model.",
+            "This is a CI concurrency signal, not a proven data race.",
+        ),
+        high=False,
+    )
+    return emit_finding(
+        rule_id=RULE_ID,
+        title="Shared mutable access across isolation domains (heuristic)",
+        symbol=symbol,
+        location=candidate.location,
+        bug_type="concurrency",
+        description=(
+            f"Shared mutable `{candidate.name}` appears accessed from isolation "
+            f"domains {domains} via [{accessors}]. {path_summary}. "
+            "Not a proven data race."
+        ),
+        risk=(
+            "Cross-isolation mutable sharing can race under concurrency. "
+            "Confirm with Swift concurrency tooling; this rule does not prove a race."
+        ),
+        path_summary=path_summary,
+        recommended_fix=(

+            "or confine access to one isolation domain."
+        ),
+        proof=proof,
+        severity="medium",
+        confidence="medium",
+    )

+"""NS3 exit goldens: isolation signals are medium and not race proofs."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations

+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from ultra_trace.engine.pipeline import analyze_unit
+from ultra_trace.reporting.json_report import finding_to_json
+from ultra_trace.swift_frontend import normalize_helper_output
+
+FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures" / "helper"
+GOLDENS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "goldens"
+
+
+def _unit() -> object:
+    payload = json.loads(
+        (FIXTURES / "isolation_signals.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    )
+    return normalize_helper_output(payload)
+
+
+def test_normalize_isolation_and_shared_mutables() -> None:
+    unit = _unit()
+    update = next(s for s in unit.symbols_by_id.values() if s.name == "updateUI")
+    bg = next(s for s in unit.symbols_by_id.values() if s.name == "backgroundWork")
+    assert update.isolation == "main_actor"
+    assert "MainActor" in update.attributes
+    assert bg.isolation == "nonisolated"
+    assert unit.shared_mutables
+    title = next(c for c in unit.shared_mutables if c.name == "title")
+    assert title.parent_type == "Screen"
+    assert title.isolation == "main_actor"
+
+

+    result = analyze_unit(_unit(), max_depth=32, rule_packs=("core", "advanced"))
+    concurrency = [f for f in result.findings if f.bug_type == "concurrency"]
+    assert concurrency
+    assert all(f.severity == "medium" for f in concurrency)
+    assert all("not a proven" in f.description.lower() for f in concurrency)
+    assert all(f.severity != "high" for f in concurrency)
+

+    assert "swift.shared_mutable_cross_isolation_signal" in by_rule

+"""NS2 async edge helpers: await / Task hops as path-relevant witnesses."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Sequence
+
+from ultra_trace.frontend.models import SourceSpan
+
+
+def task_hop_style(callee_text: str) -> str | None:
+    """Classify Task creation calls. TaskGroup and others stay unknown."""
+    text = callee_text.strip()
+    if text.endswith("()"):
+        text = text[:-2]
+    if text == "Task.detached" or text.startswith("Task.detached"):
+        return "Task.detached"
+    if text in {"Task.value", "Task.sleep", "Task.yield", "Task.checkCancellation"}:
+        return None
+    if text == "Task" or text.startswith("Task.init"):
+        return "Task"
+    return None
+
+
+def path_covers_hop(
+    hop_path: Sequence[str], event_path: Sequence[str]
+) -> bool:
+    """True when the hop occurred on the same explored trail (as a prefix)."""
+    if not hop_path:
+        return False
+    if len(hop_path) > len(event_path):
+        return False
+    return tuple(event_path[: len(hop_path)]) == tuple(hop_path)
+
+
+def uncertain_suspension_for_path(
+    event_path: Sequence[str],
+    *,
+    await_paths: Sequence[Sequence[str]],
+    task_hop_paths: Sequence[Sequence[str]],
+    flagged: bool = False,
+) -> bool:
+    """True when an await/Task hop sits on this trail or the event is flagged."""
+    if flagged:
+        return True
+    for hop_path in await_paths:
+        if path_covers_hop(hop_path, event_path):
+            return True
+    for hop_path in task_hop_paths:
+        if path_covers_hop(hop_path, event_path):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def format_async_path_notes(
+    *,
+    awaits: Sequence[tuple[tuple[str, ...], SourceSpan]],
+    task_hops: Sequence[tuple[tuple[str, ...], SourceSpan, str]],
+    event_path: Sequence[str],
+) -> str:
+    """Build path_summary fragments for await / Task hops on this trail."""
+    parts: list[str] = []
+    for hop_path, loc in awaits:
+        if path_covers_hop(hop_path, event_path):
+            parts.append(f"await@{loc.start_line}")
+    for hop_path, loc, style in task_hops:
+        if path_covers_hop(hop_path, event_path):
+            parts.append(f"task_hop={style}@{loc.start_line}")
+    if not parts:
+        return ""
+    return "; " + ", ".join(parts)
